title: llmfit: A terminal tool that One command to find what runs on your hardware
description:
Want to run LLMs locally but don't know what your hardware can handle? llmfit right-sizes models to your system. Terminal tool detects RAM, CPU, GPU, VRAM and compares against a database of thirty-three popular models—tells you exactly which ones will run. Run llmfit. Interactive TUI shows system specs, scrollable model table sorted by compatibility. Hardware detection reads RAM via sysinfo, counts CPU cores.

https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit
